flows.title: Create a dashboard
steps: Go to one.newrelic.com > All capabilities > Dashboards, and select + Create a dashboard at the top-right corner of the dashboards index.
Name the dashboard, select the account it belongs to, which cannot be changed later, and select its permissions.
Click + Add widget to add a chart, built with the query builder, or text, images or links.

flows.title: Monitor a page's load performance
steps: Go to one.newrelic.com > Synthetic monitoring > Create a monitor, and choose the Page load performance tile.
Put the URL of the page to test in the URL field.
Select at least three locations the monitor runs from and a mix of Chrome and Firefox, and set how often it checks with the Period dropdown.
Once the monitor reports, its data is on the synthetics Summary page: Synthetic monitoring, then select the monitor.

flows.title: Build a step monitor for a user workflow
steps: Go to one.newrelic.com > Synthetic monitoring > Create a monitor, and choose the User step execution tile.
Give the monitor a name, choose how often it runs, and select the browser and emulated device types and the locations it runs from.
Define the steps from the 12 prebuilt steps, for example clicking buttons to move through different pages.
Click Validate before saving the monitor, to check the steps run successfully.
